title: A study in young people and adults to learn about the medicine ritlecitinib for treatment of patchy hair loss, known by the medical term as moderate alopecia areata
official: B7981110 A Phase 3, randomized, double blind, placebo controlled study to investigate the safety and efficacy of ritlecitinib in adult and adolescent participants 12 years of age and older with moderate alopecia areata
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of ritlecitinib compared to placebo on regrowth of scalp hair.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants aged 12 years and older with a confirmed clinical diagnosis of AA with greater than 20% but less than 50% scalp hair loss.
2. Participants must have a current AA episode of hair loss ≥6 months and ≤10 years. Causes of hair loss other than AA are not allowed.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants with a history of or current malignancies, with the exception of adequately treated or excised non-metastatic basal cell or squamous cell cancer of the skin or cervical carcinoma in situ
2. Any participant known to have prior exposure to a Janus kinase inhibitor
3. Causes of hair loss other than AA
4. Adolescent participants without evidence of immunity to varicella zoster virus through vaccination or serological testing
